faq.label: Questions & answers
faq.headline: Every question you have. Answered.
faq.a1: Yes. The Free plan is permanently free — no trial period, no hidden fees. You get 10 AI questions per day, all past papers. No credit card, ever.
faq.q2: Can the AI really solve GCE questions?
faq.a2: PassMark uses advanced AI tailored to follow GCE Cameroon syllabus, past paper formats, and marking schemes for O Level and A Level.
faq.q3: How do I pay? I don't have a bank card.
faq.a3: You don't need a bank card. PassMark accepts MTN Mobile Money and Orange Money — the same way you buy data bundles or pay school fees.
faq.q4: What if the AI gives wrong answers?
faq.a4: PassMark AI is trained to follow GCE Board marking schemes. Every solution shows full working so you can verify each step. 93% of students who used PassMark reported improvement in their mock exam results.
faq.a5: Yes. PassMark securely saves your study statistics, streak records, and previous AI calculations to your account, so you can resume your preparation from any device at any time.
faq.a6: Your data stays on your device. We don't sell your information. No ads. No tracking. No surveillance. PassMark is a study tool, not a social network.
faq.a7: You can stop at any time — no penalty. Standard is monthly, so you simply don't renew next month. Premium is a one-time payment valid until June exams.
faq.q8: Will this actually help me pass?
faq.a8: The students who fail GCE are the ones who waited too long, studied alone, and had no one to explain their mistakes. PassMark gives you an AI tutor at 2am, explains every step of every past paper question, and generates practice quizzes so you find your weak points before the examiner does. The tool works. The question is: will you?
